t.welcome: Your whole life, in one calm place.
t.welcomeSub: Money, time, health and goals, with an assistant that knows all of it and tells you what matters each morning.
t.whoSub: You can add people or change plan any time.
t.usSub: Together · 2–4 people · shared and private spaces
t.planSub: 14 days free, no card needed. Cancel any time.
t.themeSub: 8 themes, each in light and dark. Green, amber and red always mean the same thing.
t.briefSub: 30 seconds each morning: money, today’s plan and one thing worth doing.
t.doneSub: Your Life Score starts after a week of data. This is what one looks like.
t.scoreSub: One number for how your life is going this week, and exactly why.
t.leverText: Go to bed 30 minutes earlier on the three nights before your morning shifts. Health goes from 58 to about 67, and your Life Score to 73.
t.whyUp: Up from 67 last week, mostly because the emergency fund passed 50% and you got two gym sessions in.
t.trendLocked: See how your score moves week by week, and what moved it.
t.membersNote: Add a partner or family with Together.
t.ppT: Private Plan: a platform built only for you
t.ppSub: Your own app, designed around your life, your business or your family. Tell us what you need and we’ll come back with a proposal.
t.ppNeed: What should it do for you?
t.ppNeedPh: e.g. Money and time for my family, plus my two small businesses
t.ppThanksSub: We’ll reply within 2 working days to book a call.
t.upSub: Upgrade now and your data stays exactly where it is. Change or cancel any time.
t.f_sub: Five steps, about 15 minutes. Do them in any order, everything stays editable.
t.f_brief: Your first morning briefing arrives tomorrow at
t.f_sample: Look around with sample data first
t.s_incomeSub: Salary, business or other, net per month
t.s_importSub: CSV or PDF from your bank, sorted automatically
t.s_budgetSub: A limit per category, warnings at 80%
t.s_subSub: Find the ones you no longer use
t.mapAsk: How is '{'x'}' doing, and what should I do next?
t.mapUnlock: Life Map is part of Life Plus
t.mapUnlockSub: See your whole life as one living map: every goal, bill and habit, coloured by how it’s going.
t.mapHint: Drag to turn · pinch or scroll to zoom · tap a dot
t.e_tax: Your tax overview builds itself from income, business months and receipts.
t.e_week: Add what’s on this week and your free time shows up here.
t.e_shifts: Add your work shifts to see hours and free evenings.
t.e_career: Add a course, book or business goal to start your career page.
t.e_sim: Add savings or investments to simulate the next 10 years.
t.e_gym: Log your first workout or sleep to start tracking health.
t.e_together: Log your first date night or save an idea for later.
t.e_whatif: What if works once you have income, a budget and a goal.
t.e_report: Your first monthly report is ready at the end of this month.
t.efSet: Set your monthly budget first, then we can size your emergency fund.
t.askHello1: Hi '{'n'}'. I can see your budget, goals, income and subscriptions, never your private journal. What do you want to figure out?
t.askHello2: Hi '{'n'}'. I can see the shared budget, goals, income and subscriptions, not anyone’s private space. What do you want to figure out?
t.q1: What should I set up first?
t.q2: How big should my emergency fund be?
t.q3: How much can I spend per day this month?

budget.title: Set your monthly budget

learn.title: Nothing to learn yet

invest.title: No savings or investments yet
invest.body: Add an account to see your net worth grow over time.
